Hi Amit / Lydia — thanks again for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so Procurement has a checklist to work from: 

Summary of what we heard
- Economic buyer: Lydia (VP of Data) will lead ROI/decision criteria (latency, unit cost per 1k tokens, and SLOs).
- Procurement & security: Amit, you’ll own vendor onboarding and PO routing. Security will scope a short questionnaire and a SOC2 artifact request.
- Timeline target: Lydia indicated org-level approval aim by ~11/10; target production pilot by ~12/15.

Decision criteria (as stated on call)
- Latency at 95th pct under 250ms for standard prompts
- Cost target: within 25% of current per-token spend once batching/quantization optimizations applied
- Security: SOC 2 type II and ability to encrypt in transit + customer-managed KMS (private deployments optional)

Immediate asks / next steps
1) I attached our vendor intake form (snowcap_vendor_intake_filled.pdf) — please confirm billing contact and PO flow sections.
2) Amit: can you confirm who in AP receives invoices (name + AP email) and whether Snowcap requires Net30/Net45 etc?
3) Lydia: can you confirm the final signoff authority and whether Legal needs to own MSA redlines or Procurement will handle first pass?
4) Our legal/ops point: I’ve looped Neha (Legal) and Sergio (Sales Ops) for any SLA/billing questions.

Attach: snowcap_vendor_intake_filled.pdf

If helpful I can put a 20-min follow-up on calendar for next Tue to walk procurement through the intake form and answer any gating questions.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Camila — thanks for the write-up, very helpful. A few clarifying items from procurement so we can queue vendor intake quickly: 

1) AP contact: Can you invoice to AP at ap@snowcap.com? We use that central mailbox and it should pick up PO numbers.
2) Payment terms: Snowcap standard is Net30 but we can do Net45 for new vendors on a case-by-case. For initial pilot we prefer Net30.
3) MSA redlines: Procurement will route any legal redlines to our Legal (Lydia copied). Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the first-pass redlines?
4) Tax & W-9: Please provide Redwood’s W-9 or tax substitute and any export controls questionnaire if applicable.

Finally, can you share a short SLA summary and a sample invoice header we can use when creating the PO? If you can get those in the next 48 hours we’ll aim to create a PO by 11/03.

Thanks,
Amit Patel
Senior Procurement Analyst, Snowcap Inc.
